messages:
alex: FYI ran a staging smoke after the Go SDK bump and noticed duplicated notification emails for the same job id. looked like many clients retried at the same offsets.
rita: any stack traces or jitter values?
alex: pasted a minimal log from the retry lib: 
```
2026-03-22T20:00:01.012Z INFO retry: seed=1632 jitter_ms=12 request=job_88 attempt=1
2026-03-22T20:00:02.013Z INFO retry: seed=1632 jitter_ms=12 request=job_89 attempt=1
2026-03-22T20:00:03.014Z INFO retry: seed=1632 jitter_ms=12 request=job_90 attempt=1
```
alex: all jitter_ms are the same because seed is derived from `time.Now().Unix()` % 4096 in the library init. Containers started within the same second end up with identical RNG sequences.
cheng: oof. we saw something similar in python years ago but that was due to forking and not reseeding. here the seed resolution is too coarse.
rita: does this explain why multiple pods retried in lockstep and triggered duplicate side-effects? also did idempotency headers get used?
alex: the webhook sender adds Idempotency-Key only when `EnableSafeReplay=true`. Our sampleapp had that flag false in the k8s manifest to reduce noise. combo of synchronized jitter + opt-out of idempotency == bad.
cheng: we should treat idempotency as default for outgoing webhooks. opt-out explicit.
rita: fix proposal: 1) change go-retry RNG seeding to use crypto/rand to generate a 64-bit seed on startup (avoid low-res time); 2) add per-request jitter derived from a sync.Pool RNG or from crypto when pool exhausted; 3) flip webhook sender to attach Idempotency-Key by default; 4) add a small default jitter floor (2-5ms) even in dev-mode to avoid thundering herd across VMs.
alex: +1. also add an integration test that spins up 5 concurrent pods on minikube and runs the thundering-herd sim to catch regressions.
cheng: I'll open the PR for the RNG/seeding change and add the test harness.
rita: I'll update sampleapp k8s manifest to enable safe replay by default and add a config note to docs.
qa-bot: scheduled nightly job: thundering-herd-sim -> staging at 03:00 UTC daily.
ci-bot: PR 4221 opened by cheng: go-retry: use crypto seed + per-request jitter. CI: running.
cheng: note: we kept jitter values deterministic when RUNNING with `--deterministic-retries` for local debugging, but that flag now documents the risk of duplicates in multi-process/dev clusters.
rita: action items: cheng (PR + e2e), alex (backup reproducer script), docs (update sampleapp README and k8s manifest), qa-bot (confirm nightly runs). Anyone object?
alex: no objections, thanks.
ci-bot: PR 4221 merged to main. 14/14 checks passed.
rita: closing. we'll watch staging alerts for 48h and revert if noise spikes. :eyes:
